name: Selphie Marian Julietta
original_name: セルフィ マリアン ジュリエッタ
source: A girl of indomitable spirit, most frequently described as 'runaway princess'. Her Majesty has no sense of hierarchy, in her eyes all are equally her subjects. Though she wants to be sensitive to the demands she places on others, she's consistently surrounded by people determined to meet those demands, and cocooned in privilege. The only one who doesn't give her her way is her mother the Queen, who she constantly struggles with for power and autonomy.
